bio: The muted, romantic and aristocratic-like atmosphere of this restaurant combines the elegance of a historic edifice with a spectacular modern streak. The 19C chateau, set in wooded parkland and appointed in a glamorous baroque vein (chandeliers, silver wallpaper), invites you to stay over in one of the plush guestrooms in the main wing. Every evening the chef conjures up a surprise menu that draws on local seasonal produce, meticulously sourced from the region’s markets. Modern, fresh and savvily devised dishes that bear witness to the skill of an accomplished craftsman....
